name: mahoraga
description: Forges file:line-grounded skills from your code, then replays your own shipped tickets blind — against a bare-model baseline — to measure whether they help. Ships the GUARD pack (8 skills + 2 Claude Code hooks), the adapt/prove engine, and `mahoraga loop`, a measured improve loop that keeps an edit only if it helps on later, held-out tickets (Linux + Docker).
